# GENERATED by tools/gen.py from tools/inline_editor/common/scripted_effects/rn_inline_subjects.txt - edit the source.
# Subject rename (overlord renames a subject: country name and adjective, leader, ruling party).
# Rules (docs/API-DECISIONS.md 6 and the 2026-10-11 corrections): the acting player renames only
# their own country, or a subject of it; a human subject has no veto. Checked here, in the effect,
# because a scripted GUI command does not carry who sent it and the game does not repeat the
# button's visible/enabled triggers. ROOT is the acting player; the target is pinned at opening in
# ROOT.rn_sub_target (one-element array rn_sub_target_arr) and never taken from the command scope.
# Cooldowns are the in-place editor's, stored on the subject (rn_ip_cd_*_until on that country), so
# a subject that is renamed by its overlord and by its own player shares one cooldown per type.
# Without CAPIE the editors still open (the field is a native widget) but Apply ends with
# error 10 and changes nothing.

# Opening (called in the subject's scope from the diplomacy view; ROOT = the player).
rn_sub_open_common = {
	ROOT = {
		rn_fp_close = yes
		rn_pp_close = yes
		clr_country_flag = rn_fac_open
		clr_country_flag = rn_sub_open_country
		clr_country_flag = rn_sub_open_leader
		clr_country_flag = rn_sub_open_party
		clear_array = rn_sub_target_arr
		add_to_array = { rn_sub_target_arr = PREV }
		set_variable = { rn_sub_target = PREV }
		add_to_variable = { rn_sub_epoch = 1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sub_epoch > 999999 } } set_variable = { rn_sub_epoch = 1 } }
		rn_cv1_status_clear = yes
	}
}

rn_sub_close = {
	clr_country_flag = rn_sub_open_country
	clr_country_flag = rn_sub_open_leader
	clr_country_flag = rn_sub_open_party
	clear_array = rn_sub_target_arr
	clear_variable = rn_sub_target
	add_to_variable = { rn_sub_epoch = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sub_epoch > 999999 } } set_variable = { rn_sub_epoch = 1 } }
}

# Guard (ROOT scope). Input temp rn_sub_kind: 1 country, 2 leader, 3 party. Sets rn_cv1_err.
rn_sub_guard = {
	set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_open = rn_sub_epoch }
	rn_cv1_header = yes
	# Host switches (ADR-0036): other countries, and the switch of the edited kind.
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				rn_feature_subjects_off = yes
				AND = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_sub_kind = 1 } rn_feature_country_off = yes }
				AND = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_sub_kind = 2 } rn_feature_leader_off = yes }
				AND = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_sub_kind = 3 } rn_feature_party_off = yes }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 21 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 }
			OR = {
				is_ai = yes
				has_country_flag = rn_open
				has_country_flag = rn_input
				NOT = { has_variable = rn_sub_target }
				NOT = { check_variable = { rn_sub_target_arr^num = 1 } }
				NOT = { var:rn_sub_target = { rn_sub_may_edit = yes } }
				AND = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_sub_kind = 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_sub_open_country } }
				AND = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_sub_kind = 2 } NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_sub_open_leader } }
				AND = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_sub_kind = 3 } NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_sub_open_party } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 }
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_sub_kind = 1 } var:rn_sub_target = { rn_ip_cooldown_active_country = yes } }
				AND = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_sub_kind = 2 } var:rn_sub_target = { rn_ip_cooldown_active_leader = yes } }
				AND = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_sub_kind = 3 } var:rn_sub_target = { rn_ip_cooldown_active_party = yes } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 11 }
	}
}

# Country name and adjective of the subject, through the single country-name carrier.
rn_sub_apply_country = {
	set_temp_variable = { rn_sub_kind = 1 }
	rn_sub_guard = yes
	# The country name layer needs API level 4 (CONTRACT section 14): an older CAPIE would accept the
	# Apply, start the cooldown and fire the news event while showing nothing (review 2026-10-27).
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { temp_var:capie_cap > 3 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 15 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } } rn_cv1_take_two = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } }
		rn_inline_party_copy_validated = yes
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cn_src = 2 }
		var:rn_sub_target = {
			rn_country_name_carrier_set = yes
			rn_ip_cooldown_start_country = yes
		}
		rn_sub_close = yes
	}
	rn_cv1_status_record = yes
}

# Leader of the subject (its current country leader).
rn_sub_apply_leader = {
	set_temp_variable = { rn_sub_kind = 2 }
	rn_sub_guard = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } } rn_cv1_take_one = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_nativeb_len = 0 }
		rn_inline_party_copy_validated = yes
		var:rn_sub_target = {
			every_character = {
				limit = { is_country_leader = yes }
				meta_effect = {
					text = { set_character_name = "[N]" }
					N = "[ROOT.RN_PS_0][ROOT.RN_PS_1][ROOT.RN_PS_2][ROOT.RN_PS_3][ROOT.RN_PS_4][ROOT.RN_PS_5][ROOT.RN_PS_6][ROOT.RN_PS_7][ROOT.RN_PS_8][ROOT.RN_PS_9][ROOT.RN_PS_10][ROOT.RN_PS_11][ROOT.RN_PS_12][ROOT.RN_PS_13][ROOT.RN_PS_14][ROOT.RN_PS_15][ROOT.RN_PS_16][ROOT.RN_PS_17][ROOT.RN_PS_18][ROOT.RN_PS_19][ROOT.RN_PS_20][ROOT.RN_PS_21][ROOT.RN_PS_22][ROOT.RN_PS_23][ROOT.RN_PS_24][ROOT.RN_PS_25][ROOT.RN_PS_26][ROOT.RN_PS_27][ROOT.RN_PS_28][ROOT.RN_PS_29][ROOT.RN_PS_30][ROOT.RN_PS_31]"
				}
			}
			rn_ip_cooldown_start_leader = yes
		}
		rn_sub_close = yes
	}
	rn_cv1_status_record = yes
}
